headline.head: JUST SURVIVED. NOW SHOPPING.
headline.sub: Sergio's empty WR slot spared the commissioner by 3.6 points. Forty-eight hours later the commissioner bid on four of Sergio's starters and left with Kittle and Pickens for $318. Flowers were not sent.

jabs.flop: Even the commissioner's own waiver claims refuse to start for him.
jabs.benched: Overpaid in Week 2, under-started in Week 4. Vladimir Tuten contains multitudes.
jabs.lowball: Four managers valued Vele between $26 and $62. maruniak offered bus fare.
jabs.steal: Found twelve free points and parked them on the bench. Half a genius.

paper.obituary: Started an empty slot. Left $1,000 unspent. Survived by a fully furnished bench.

jokes.premise: collusion rumor, commissioner declined to comment
jokes.text: The commissioner survived by 3.6 points because Sergio did not set his lineup, then spent $318 on Sergio's former tight end and receiver. The Gazette is not alleging collusion. The group chat is. The commissioner declined to comment, which is exactly what a commissioner would do.

jokes.premise: five moves on Monday, none of them the move
jokes.text: The group chat begged. On Monday afternoon Sergio finally opened the app and made five moves in twenty minutes: picked up Noah Fant, Bryce Lance and Michael Penix, dropped two others, and started none of the new arrivals. Five moves. None of them the move. He went into the week with an empty WR slot and Jalen Coker, who was ruled out late and scored 0.0.

jokes.premise: the answer was on his own bench
jokes.text: The answer was already on his roster: Kenny Gainwell scored 10.7 on Sergio's bench. Diggs to WR, Gainwell to FLEX, and Sergio lives at 98.1. The new WR and TE would not have saved him; together they scored 1.7. Gainwell would have.
jackmccarthy25 paid $59 for Jalen Coker, the 0.0 that ended the previous owner. Bold to buy the murder weapon at the estate sale.

matthewmongelli finally broke the seal: $70 on RJ Harvey, another Sergio heirloom. That leaves $930 in the mattress for a team that finished 10th of 13. FAAB is not a 401(k). There is no employer match. Don't try to make up for your real savings with fake FAAB money.

jokes.premise: second in points, never opened the waiver tab
jokes.text: jackmccarthy25 finished second this week with $941 still untouched, which is either iron discipline or a man who has never found the waiver tab.
PumpUpTheJam32 went $114 clear of the next bid for Omarion Hampton. He scored 13.3, so the premium alone came to about $8.60 a point.
maruniak lost Jaylen Waddle by one dollar, $22 to Vladimir Tuten's $23. The losing bid cost nothing, which is also what it got him.

jokes.premise: bought Goedert to guard the bench
jokes.text: Also on the commissioner's ledger: $48 for Dallas Goedert, who scored 0.0 from the bench. Some men buy players. The commissioner buys furniture.

THE GREAT DEBATE: Maye Defenders had their week at last, 27.16 points, three touchdowns and a road win in Buffalo. Nix Believers point to the season ledger (60.26 to 54.76) and the interception column (7 to 4), and would prefer not to discuss Denver's loss to San Francisco.

ELSEWHERE IN IMPOSSIBLE NEWS: the Cleveland Browns are 3-1 and top of the AFC North after a 56-yard field goal beat Pittsburgh with ten seconds left. Scientists are calling it unprecedented; Browns fans are calling it a trap.
Cleveland even introduced Deshaun Watson last this week. Sources say he has found a new masseuse in town. The Gazette has no further questions.

jokes.premise: Kittle vintage performance for Sergio, now JSN's
jokes.text: George Kittle had a vintage Sunday in San Francisco's win, 17.0 points for Sergio, who did manage to start him. The commissioner now owns that vintage at $222 a bottle.

jokes.premise: went $104 clear for Kittle, grief makes people generous
jokes.text: THE BIDDING WAR: the commissioner went $104 clear of the next bid for George Kittle, $222 against maruniak's $118. Grief makes people generous.

jokes.premise: won Swift by a dollar after losing Waddle by a dollar
jokes.text: maruniak won D'Andre Swift by one dollar, $126 to Always Safe's $125, one week after losing Jaylen Waddle by one dollar. The universe has returned his dollar.

jokes.premise: bid on four of Sergio's starters
jokes.text: The commissioner also bid $69 on RJ Harvey and lost him to matthewmongelli by a dollar. For those keeping count, that is four of Sergio's starters he put in claims for. The Gazette reports this without comment.

jokes.premise: most enthusiastic mourner at the estate sale
jokes.text: Most enthusiastic mourner at the estate sale: maruniak, who put in claims on six of Sergio's former players and came home with one.

REPEAT OFFENDER: BDALOHA, convicted in Week 3 of benching a $299 Tony Pollard, left Tyquan Thornton's 28.1 points on the bench this week. That is the highest score anyone in the league put on a bench. At this point the bench is not a bench, it is a second team.
